title: Oblation
summary: OBLA'TION, noun [Latin oblatio, from offero; ob and fero, to bear or bring.] Any thing offered or presented in worship or sacred service; an offering; a sacrifice. Bring no more vain oblations. Isaiah

inlines.v: OBLA'TION, noun [Latin oblatio, from offero; ob and fero, to bear or bring.] Any thing offered or presented in worship or sacred service; an offering; a sacrifice. Bring no more vain oblations. Isaiah 1:13.
